description: Config-as-data for the a2a/intent-ibac-gateway app: the intent dataset (CanBank graph and its KBAC policies, the Intent Agent's whole vocabulary) with one identity type: every login is a Person whose external_id is an Auth0 subject (the people of the ibac dataset), staff WORKS_IN a Department and customers IS_CUSTOMER a Customer record, so being a customer is found on the graph, never in the token. Plus what six IndyKite Agent Gateways need in front of the fleet: an Agent node per fleet agent (external_id = the sub of the gateway's Auth0 Machine-to-Machine token, <client_id>@clients, supplied by .env as AUTH0_SUB_<AGENT>), one Workflow per agent with INVOKES edges that carry workflow_name, CAN_TRIGGER edges from departments and customer records, one admission policy that compares the delegation chain ($ik_token.act_chain) with the workflow path, one Skill node per card skill with HAS edges from its Agent (workflow_name) and the person-can-use-skill policy the gateways filter the extended card with (case-decisions hangs on the supervisor's own workflow), and two token-introspect configurations: the Auth0 tenant for the people's access tokens (AUTH0_ISSUER) and the Token Service issuer for the delegated tokens in X-IK-Token, both typed Person. The Token Service public key comes from the .env placeholder TOKEN_SERVICE_PUBLIC_JWK, so run the demo's `make keys` before provisioning.

app_agent.name: intent-ibac-agent
app_agent.description: App agent used by the Intent Agent (data schema + policy listing), the six Agent Gateways (whoami + admission) and the demo console (AuthZEN decisions)

token_introspect.name: auth0-people
token_introspect.description: Auth0 access tokens of the people (API audience ibac-people), validated against the tenant JWKS; the token sub is the Person external_id (auth0|<id>). The issuer comes from .env (AUTH0_ISSUER, e.g. https://<tenant>.auth0.com/). whoami resolves the caller of every gateway request through it.

token_introspect.name: token-service-intent-ibac
token_introspect.description: Delegated tokens the gateways mint at the Token Service for the caller (audience intent-ibac-agents), arriving in X-IK-Token on the admission call. Typed Person like the callers' tokens. Public key from .env (TOKEN_SERVICE_PUBLIC_JWK, printed by the demo's `make keys`).

kbac.name: user-can-trigger-workflow
kbac.description: A user can trigger an agentic workflow when their department can trigger it or they were assigned to it directly.

kbac.name: user-works-in-department
kbac.description: The department a user works in directly.

kbac.name: user-works-under-department
kbac.description: Whether the user works under the department named by $department (required input parameter).

kbac.name: user-reports-to
kbac.description: The user's direct manager.

kbac.name: user-reports-to-indirectly
kbac.description: Managers two or more levels above the user.

kbac.name: user-can-query-colleague
kbac.description: Gate for questions about another user: a user may ask about colleagues of the same department. The Intent Agent emits this evaluation first when a prompt names another user.

kbac.name: user-can-retrieve-quote
kbac.description: Staff in a department allowed to retrieve a quote.

kbac.name: user-can-access-folder
kbac.description: Folders the user's department can access.

kbac.name: user-can-access-folder-document
kbac.description: Documents inside the folders the user's department can access.

kbac.name: user-can-disclose-document
kbac.description: Documents reachable through the user's department, folders and containment (up to four hops).

kbac.name: staff-can-view-invoice
kbac.description: Staff can view the invoices of the customers their department serves.

kbac.name: user-can-access-customer
kbac.description: Customers contained in the system named by $system (required input parameter) that the user's department can access.

kbac.name: user-affected-account
kbac.description: Accounts touched by a decision the user made (decision closed a ticket regarding the account).

kbac.name: customer-can-query-fellow-customer
kbac.description: Gate for questions about another customer: customers served by the same department. The Intent Agent emits this evaluation first when a prompt names another customer.

kbac.name: customer-owns-account
kbac.description: The customer's own accounts.

kbac.name: customer-has-account-tier
kbac.description: Whether the customer owns an account of the tier named by $tier (required input parameter).

kbac.name: customer-views-invoice
kbac.description: The customer's own invoices.

kbac.name: customer-views-unpaid-invoice
kbac.description: The customer's open invoices: the invoice's state is a HAS_STATUS relationship to an InvoiceStatus node, so the condition is a traversal plus an external_id equality.

kbac.name: customer-views-account-category
kbac.description: Investment categories of the accounts the customer owns.

kbac.name: customer-views-product-document
kbac.description: Documents classified under an investment category the customer holds an account in.

kbac.name: customer-views-ticket-decision
kbac.description: Decisions that closed a ticket the customer opened.

kbac.name: user-works-under-departments
kbac.description: Every department above the user's own in the org tree; the parameter-less twin of WORKS_UNDER_DEPARTMENT.

kbac.name: user-can-list-customers
kbac.description: Customers in any system the user's department can access; the parameter-less twin of CAN_ACCESS_CUSTOMER.

kbac.name: customer-has-account-tiers
kbac.description: Tiers of every account the customer owns; the parameter-less twin of HAS.

kbac.name: person-can-reach-agent
kbac.description: Admission of a gateway: the caller (a Person, through a department they work in, a customer record they hold, or directly) may trigger a workflow whose INVOKES path equals the delegation chain the gateway sends in X-IK-Token.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person)-[:WORKS_IN|IS_CUSTOMER|CAN_TRIGGER*..3]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(resource:Agent) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain

kbac.name: person-can-use-skill
kbac.description: Capability check of a gateway in front of an A2A agent: which skills of the agent's card the caller may use. The gateway reads the set with one AuthZEN search/resource (action CAN_USE, type Skill) and answers the authenticated extended card with those skills only. The first half is the admission condition; h.workflow_name confines a skill to one workflow, which is how case-decisions is the supervisor's alone.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person)-[:WORKS_IN|IS_CUSTOMER|CAN_TRIGGER*..3]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(agent:Agent)-[h:HAS]->(resource:Skill) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain AND h.workflow_name = wf.external_id

application.name: intent-ibac-app
application.description: Application that fronts the Intent Agent + IBAC demo console and its six Agent Gateways

project.name: intent-ibac-gateway
project.description: Project for the Intent Agent + IBAC demo: CanBank graph, the Intent Agent's policies, the fleet's agents and workflows, the gateways' admission policies and token introspects
